extract_data.description: Pull structured values out of a document (invoice totals, contract dates, form answers) as named fields you can use in later steps. List the fields you want, or leave them blank and let Extend work out the shape of the document for you.
extract_data.display_str_template: Extract data from a document with Extend.
extract_data.name: extract_data

parameters.description: The document to extract from: upload one here, give its public URL, or pass the file id from an earlier Extend step. Uploaded files are sent to Extend first.
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: Optional. The values to pull out, each with a name and a description of what to look for. Leave this empty to let Extend infer the fields from the document itself.
parameters.name: fields

description.description: What to look for, e.g. 'The invoice number printed in the header'.

name.description: What to call this field, e.g. 'invoice_number'.

type.description: The kind of value: 'string', 'number', 'integer', 'boolean', or 'list' for a list of text values. Defaults to 'string'.

parameters.description: Optional. Plain-language rules for the extraction, e.g. 'Return dates as YYYY-MM-DD and amounts without a currency symbol'. When no fields are listed above, this also tells Extend what kind of document to expect.
parameters.name: extraction_rules

parameters.description: Optional. Which engine to extract with. Defaults to the high-accuracy engine.
parameters.name: engine

options.label: Light - faster and cheaper for simple documents

dashboard_url.description: Link to review this run in the Extend dashboard

data.description: The extracted values, one key per field you asked for (or per field Extend inferred)

extract_run_id.description: Extend's id for this extraction run

field_metadata.description: Per-field confidence and the text in the document each value came from

confidence.description: How confident Extend is in this value, from 0 to 1

field.description: The name of the extracted field

page.description: The page the value was found on

reference_text.description: The text in the document the value was read from

file_id.description: Extend's id for the file, reusable in a later Extend step

file_name.description: The name of the file that was read

parse_document.description: Turn a PDF, image, spreadsheet, presentation, or scan into clean, layout-aware markdown split into chunks: ready to feed into a later AI step, a search index, or a RAG pipeline.

parse_document.name: parse_document

parameters.description: The document to parse: upload one here, give its public URL, or pass the file id from an earlier Extend step. Uploaded files are sent to Extend first, then parsed.
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: Optional. How to divide the document. Defaults to one chunk per page.
parameters.name: chunking_strategy

options.label: Sections (splits at headings, best for search)

parameters.description: Optional. Which engine to parse with. Defaults to the high-accuracy engine.
parameters.name: engine

options.label: Performance - highest accuracy for complex tables, handwriting, and checkboxes (default)
Light - faster and cheaper for high-volume, good-quality documents

parameters.description: Optional. How tables are written into the parsed content. Defaults to HTML, which handles merged cells and nested headers.
parameters.name: table_format

options.label: HTML - complex tables with merged cells (default)
Markdown - simple tables and LLM workflows

parameters.description: Optional. Also return every element on the page individually -- each table, figure, heading, and key-value pair -- with the page it came from.
parameters.name: include_blocks

parameters.description: Optional. Parse only from this page onwards. Set the last page too. You are only billed for the pages parsed.
parameters.name: page_start

parameters.description: Optional. Parse up to and including this page. Set the first page too.
parameters.name: page_end

blocks.description: Individual page elements. Empty unless 'Include element breakdown' is on.

content.description: The element's content, formatted for its type

page.description: The page the element appears on

type.description: The kind of element: 'text', 'heading', 'table', 'figure', 'key_value', 'formula', 'barcode', and more

chunks.description: The parsed content, split into chunks

page_end.description: Last page of the document this chunk covers

page_start.description: First page of the document this chunk covers

type.description: The unit this chunk covers: 'page', 'section', or 'document'

content.description: The whole document as markdown, with every chunk joined in reading order

file_id.description: Extend's id for the parsed file, reusable in a later Extend step

file_name.description: The name of the parsed file

parse_run_id.description: Extend's id for this parse run

description: Turn documents into clean, LLM-ready markdown and pull structured data out of them with Extend's document processing AI.
